agentic.title: Agentic commerce (ACP)

points: Agentic Commerce Protocol (Apache 2.0) — adopted by ChatGPT, other platforms may follow.
Instant Checkout: direct purchases in the assistant without leaving the interface.
Your product feeds must comply with the Product Feed Spec to be eligible.

features.desc: JSON/CSV export compatible with OpenAI Product Feed Spec — required fields, variants, formats.

features.title: Ready for tomorrow

items.q: How do I sign up for ChatGPT Shopping?
items.a: Go to chatgpt.com/merchants and fill out the form. Access is by application. Prepare your merchant info (seller_url, return_policy) and a sample feed (~100 products) if requested.

items.q: Does FeedPlug automatically push to ChatGPT?
items.a: Currently you export the feed from FeedPlug. Automation (push to OpenAI endpoint) will come after partner approval. For now, an export + delivery script works for daily updates.

items.q: Is agentic commerce only for ChatGPT?
items.a: For now, the Agentic Commerce Protocol is mainly adopted by ChatGPT. Other platforms (Perplexity, etc.) could join. Preparing now puts your feeds in the right formats.

items.q: How do I optimize my Google Shopping feed?
items.a: FeedPlug imports your catalog, enriches it with AI (titles, descriptions), computes a quality score and exports a Google Merchant Center-compliant feed. Centralize once, distribute everywhere.

items.a: FeedPlug automatically adapts your data to Amazon's requirements: mandatory attributes (EAN, brand, category), variants, bullet points optimized for the A9 algorithm. Export ready for Seller Central, no development needed.

items.q: Does FeedPlug support Cdiscount and Rakuten?

items.a: Yes. FeedPlug distributes to Google Shopping, Google Merchant Center, Meta, Amazon and marketplaces (Cdiscount, Rakuten, Mirakl, Fnac, etc.). One source, exports adapted to each channel.

items.q: How do I quickly launch on new channels?

items.q: Why FeedPlug instead of a spreadsheet?
items.a: A spreadsheet forces you to maintain multiple files, manually reformat for each channel and handle errors yourself. FeedPlug centralizes one catalog, automatically adapts formats (Google Merchant Center, Amazon, Cdiscount, etc.), computes a quality score and alerts on errors. Time saved and fewer rejections.
